claims.text: The address is 108 East Superior Street, at North Michigan Avenue.

findings.quote: 108 East Superior Street (at North Michigan Avenue), Chicago, Illinois 60611, USA

claims.text: The Peninsula Chicago brings traditional Asian service to Chicago.

findings.quote: The Peninsula Chicago brings traditional Asian service to a city already renowned for the warmth of its hospitality.

claims.text: Rooms and suites look out over Michigan Avenue, the historic Water Tower and Lake Michigan.

findings.quote: Timeless interiors and abundant natural light frame far-reaching outlooks over Michigan Avenue, the historic Water Tower and Lake Michigan.

claims.text: Shanghai Terrace serves contemporary Chinese cuisine under Chef de Cuisine Elmo Han.

findings.quote: Shanghai Terrace presents a contemporary approach to Chinese dining under the direction of Chef de Cuisine Elmo Han.

claims.text: Shanghai Terrace's menu features traditional Cantonese dishes and a dim sum program.

findings.quote: The menu features beloved and traditional Cantonese dishes alongside creative interpretations of the classics, including an acclaimed dim sum program.

claims.text: Pierrot Gourmet is a street-side cafe with fresh pastries.

findings.quote: Street-side lifestyle café with fresh pastries and local favourites

claims.text: The Peninsula Spa and Wellness Center occupies the 19th and 20th floors of the hotel.

findings.quote: Occupying the 19th and 20th floors of the hotel, The Peninsula Spa & Wellness Center will have you feeling on top of the world in more ways than one.

claims.text: The spa's treatments are inspired by Ayurvedic and Asian philosophies.

findings.quote: extensive menu of both modern and timeless treatments inspired by Ayurvedic and Asian philosophies

claims.text: The spa has a relaxation lounge with a fireplace and a yoga studio.

findings.quote: a relaxation lounge with a fireplace, a fully equipped Fitness Center, and a yoga studio.

claims.text: The pool area includes an indoor hot tub and an outdoor Sun Terrace.

findings.quote: surround The Peninsula’s indoor half-Olympic size swimming pool, complete with an indoor hot tub and outdoor Sun Terrace.

claims.text: Pets are welcome, with welcome amenities, pet walking services and a doggie and kitty room service menu.

findings.quote: From special welcome amenities and pet walking services to a doggie and kitty room service menu, your pets will be treated like the VIPs they truly are.

claims.text: The Peninsula Suite has a baby grand piano and a wrap-around terrace overlooking Lake Michigan.

findings.quote: Expect every amenity, from a baby grand piano to wrap-around terrace overlooking Lake Michigan.

claims.text: In the warmer months, Shanghai Terrace opens an outdoor terrace on the 4th floor for lunch, cocktails and dinner.

findings.quote: During the warmer Chicago months, Shanghai Terrace opens its doors to The Terrace for lunch, cocktails and dinner al fresco.
Adjacent to Shanghai Terrace and located on the 4th floor of The Peninsula Chicago

claims.text: The indoor pool is on the 19th floor, with views of Lake Michigan and the city through floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: The Peninsula Chicago’s coveted indoor pool, located on the 19th floor, offers breathtaking views of Lake Michigan and the city through 20-foot floor-to-ceiling windows.

claims.text: The hotel's original interiors are Parisian Art Deco.

findings.quote: remain true to The Peninsula Chicago's original Parisian Art Deco interiors

claims.text: Z Bar is the hotel's rooftop lounge, with an outdoor terrace and city views.

findings.quote: Experience Z Bar, our rooftop lounge inspired by the world’s cultural and culinary riches. Featuring iconic views of the city, the outdoor terrace is an ideal place to experience Chicago’s wonders.

claims.text: The Sun Terrace next to the pool is open seasonally.

findings.quote: Open seasonally and located on the 19th floor adjacent to The Pool

claims.text: A minimum age of 18 applies for spa access and most treatments, with exceptions for facials and nail services.

findings.quote: A minimum age of 18 is required for access within the Spa and for treatments, with the exception of facials (minimum age of 16 is required) and nail services

claims.text: Pet amenities and services may incur additional fees, and a pet waiver must be signed on arrival.

findings.quote: Pet amenities and services may incur additional fees. A pet waiver form must be signed upon arrival.
